data.name: Muqassam
data.gender_notes: Muqassam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who strikes or pounds. In the Quran, Allah (swt) strikes a covenant between Himself and the believers (2:286). The name Muqassam carries the meaning “To strike, to pound” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muqassam usually hope their child will grow to embody to strike, to pound and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing determination and strength in upholding one's faith.
data.etymology: Muqassam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To strike, to pound.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muqassam total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مقسم
in_arabic.long_meaning: المقسم هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الذي يقسم ويوزع الرزق والمكانات بين عباده، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام: 'وَيَقْسِمُ الرِزْقَ مَنْ يَشَاءُ'، وقد وردت هذه الآية لتبين قدرة الله تعالى على تقسيم الأرزاق والمنازل بين الناس وفقًا لما يرى من المصلحة لعباده، ويدل على عظيم قدرته وعدله في إدارة الكون

in_urdu.name: مقسم
in_urdu.meaning: وہ جو دیتا ہے، بانٹتا ہے، تقسیم کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مقسم اللہ تعالیٰ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ جو اپنے عبادت گزاروں میں رزق اور مختلف حیثیتوں کو تقسیم کرتا ہے، قرآن مجید میں سورہ انعام میں اس کا ذکر ہے: 'وَيَقْسِمُ الرِزْقَ مَنْ يَشَاءُ'، یہ آیت اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت کو ظاہر کرتی ہے کہ وہ اپنے بندوں کے درمیان رزق اور مختلف حیثیتوں کو اپنی مرضی کے مطابق تقسیم کرتا ہے، اور یہ اس کے عظیم الشان اور انصاف پر دلالت کرتا ہے۔ عالم کی تدبیر میں

in_hindi.name: मुक़स्सम
in_hindi.meaning: वह जो देता है, बांटता है, विभाजन करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुक़स्सम अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है कि वह जो अपने उपासकों के बीच में संपत्ति और विभिन्न दर्जों को विभाजित करता है, कुरआन में सूरह अन्आम में इसका उल्लेख है: 'وَيَقْسِمُ الرِزْقَ مَنْ يَشَاءُ' यह आयत अल्लाह की शक्ति को प्रदर्शित करती है कि वह अपने सेवकों के बीच में संपत्ति और विभिन्न दर्जों को अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार विभाजित करता है, और यह उसके महान और न्याय पर द्योतक है। संसार के प्रबंधन में

in_english.name: Muqassam
in_english.long_meaning: Muqassam is one of the beautiful names of Allah, signifying the One who distributes and allocates sustenance and ranks among His servants. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah An'am: 'And He distributes [among His creatures] what He wills.' (6:65) This name highlights Allah's power to allocate resources and positions as He sees fit, demonstrating His great wisdom and justice in managing the universe. It implies a sense of provision, division, and allocation based on divine wisdom.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muqassam is an Arabic term that holds a unique cultural significance. Muqassam is derived from the Arabic roots "qus-s-m" which translates to 'strikes' or 'pounds'. In various Islamic contexts, this name is also attributed to individuals who held significant roles in Islamic history, such as Muqassam ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Kindi, a renowned scholarly figure and philosopher of the Islamic Golden Age. This name's cultural impact lies in its association with these historical figures, representing intellect, wisdom, and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Muqassam holds deep significance. In Islamic teachings, Allah (swt) is described as the Al-Muqassis, the One Who Strikes or the One Who Assails. This is a metaphor for Allah's ability to strike down adversity and hardships, answer prayers, and bring about change in one's life. Additionally, the Quranic verse 2:286 mentions "Muqassisat" (blessings), which implies Allah's promise to bestow His blessings upon those who adhere to the covenant. Consequently, the name Muqassam carries a powerful reminder of Allah's All-Powerful ability and His blessings that come forth through adhering to faith and obedience.
